authorship: Twenty original project Python modules; ten unchanged numerical/core modules and ten newly authored paired-executor modules. No copied or transliterated historical MATLAB is bundled.

code_amendment.reason: Bind the canonical representation actually published; the complete inverse establishes equality outside provenance. No scientific field or decision changes.

code_terms: The retained project MIT notice in LICENSE.txt covers original project source only. Dataset CC0 is not a grant for historical software. External original MATLAB remains unbundled and its terms unresolved.
excluded: No authentic EEG/audio/header/event/behavior/answer/array/weight, credential, raw stimulus dictionary, model transcript, primary full text or original third-party code.
prior_notices: PUBLICATION.md and PUBLIC_PROVENANCE.json are exact notices for the preceding ten-module release. Their module counts and unchanged-code statements refer to that release, not this paired-executor update.
remaining_gates: All thirteen canonical holds remain open. Generic execution is disabled; inspect only. Concrete source does not establish authentic intake, provider isolation, physical storage, token bounds, reference competence, native runtime parity or scientific results.
unpublished_evidence: Private original source/review bodies, control receipts, source history and complete inverse are not distributed. Null-path descriptors retain the original length/hash, never a summary identity. No execution receipt or hidden target is exported.
